entries.name: Armando Al Pantheon
entries.address: Salita de' Crescenzi 31, Centro Storico, Rome
entries.description: Six decades of family ownership. Book ahead—toughest last-minute reservation in Rome. Order: rigatoni amatriciana, spaghetti alla carbonara, saltimbocca alla romana, tripe in tomato. Closed Sundays.

entries.name: La Tavernaccia Da Bruno
entries.address: Via Giovanni da Castelbolognese 63, Trastevere, Rome
entries.description: Trastevere institution. Time-capsule trattoria with a novel-length wine list. Order: eggplant parmigiana, coda alla vaccinara, maialino, Sunday lasagna, torta caprese.

entries.name: Trattoria Da Enzo Al 29
entries.description: Perpetual line out the door. Killer carbonara and artichokes. Aperol spritz while you wait.

entries.name: Pecorino
entries.description: White-tablecloth Roman trattoria in Testaccio with sarcastic waiters. Order: carbonara, maltagliati con carciofi, zabaione cake. Sunday lunch feels like family.

entries.name: Ristorante Rocco
entries.description: Single dinner seating, cursive chalkboard specials. Polished terrazzo, relaxed enough for celebrities. Order: cacio e pepe.

entries.name: La Matriciana Dal 1870
entries.description: Since 1870, across from the Opera House. Sharp waiters, local crowd. Order: prosciutto from the bone, fresh Campania mozzarella, velvety gricia, tortellini in brodo.

entries.name: Romanè
entries.description: From the Trapizzino team. Lace placemats, painted ceramic plates. Order: ultra-creamy carbonara with crispy guanciale; excellent biodynamic wine list.

entries.name: Dar Filettaro
entries.address: Largo dei Librari 88, Campo de' Fiori, Rome
entries.description: Iconic baccalà (crispy fried salted cod) + puntarelle on a lively piazza. Cheap eats, sit outside.

entries.name: Pulejo
entries.address: Via Giovanni da Castelbolognese, Prati, Rome
entries.description: Infatuation reviewed Prati spot. Italian cooking in a stylish setting.

entries.name: Fraschetta Da Sandro
entries.description: Testaccio fraschetta. Infatuation-reviewed Italian trattoria.

entries.name: Trapizzino Testaccio
entries.description: The original street-corner pizza-pocket temple. Order: supplì, trippa alla romana, pollo alla cacciatora stuffed in pizza dough pockets.

entries.name: Giolitti
entries.address: Via degli Uffici del Vicario 40, Pantheon, Rome
entries.description: Since 1900. Legendary gelateria near the Pantheon. Order: pistachio + zabaione. Bright green signage, impossible to miss.

entries.name: Fiordiluna
entries.description: Trastevere locals' favorite. Order: mascarpone with chocolate & biscuit, pistachio, yogurt. Homemade jams to take home.

entries.name: Gelateria Del Teatro
entries.description: Creative flavors in a 4-min walk from Piazza Navona. Order: white chocolate & basil, dark chocolate + Nero d'Avola wine. Also granita.

entries.name: Otaleg
entries.address: Via di San Cosimato 14, Trastevere, Rome
entries.description: Name = 'gelato' backwards. Founded by a pioneer of gourmet gelato. Order: pistachio + dark chocolate, stracciatella. Seasonal dairy-free fruit flavors.

entries.name: Neve Di Latte
entries.address: Via dei Banchi Vecchi 140, Centro Storico, Rome
entries.description: Milk from Upper Bavaria. Order: Sicilian ricotta with candied orange & chocolate, chestnut cream, sour cherry with chocolate and nuts.

entries.name: Gelateria Fassi (Palazzo del Freddo)
entries.description: Since 1880. Rome's oldest gelato. Family museum vibe. Order: zabaione, vanilla bourbon with peanuts & cocoa nibs. Fall: persimmon flavor.

entries.name: Fatamorgana Gelato
entries.address: Via dei Chiavari 37A, Campo de' Fiori, Rome
entries.description: Around the corner from Roscioli. Rotating flavors. Order: Bronte pistachio, milk-mint-chocolate—mint so fresh it beats Listerine.

entries.name: Il Gelato Di Claudio Torcè
entries.description: 4 shops across the city. Order: black sesame with salted caramel, ricotta with saffron, halva gelato. Favorite: salted chocolate with pink Himalayan salt.

entries.name: Gelateria Dei Gracchi
entries.description: Near the Vatican. Order: ricotta & pear, toasted almond with candied orange. Vegan pistachio is ultra-creamy.

entries.name: Antico Forno Roscioli
entries.address: Via dei Chiavari 34, Campo de' Fiori, Rome
entries.description: The Roscioli dynasty's bakery. Order: pizza rossa, pizza con patate with porchetta, supplì, ciambelline, ricotta chocolate chip crostata, maritozzo.

entries.name: Pasticceria Boccione
entries.address: Via del Portico d'Ottavia 1, Jewish Ghetto, Rome
entries.description: Only remaining kosher bakery in the historic Jewish Ghetto. Run by kind sisters. Order: ricotta & wild cherry tart, pizza ebraica. Don't mind the cracked crust—it's part of the charm.

entries.name: Pasticceria Regoli
entries.description: Century-old institution near Termini. Opens 6:30AM—sold out by noon. Order: maritozzo (mountain of whipped cream), wild strawberry tarts, pistachio cream-filled cornetti.

entries.name: Forno Campo De' Fiori
entries.description: Behind the flower sellers. Order: pizza al taglio, pizza bianca with tomato or thinly sliced potatoes, pizza stuffed with mortadella or zucchini flowers, reginelle sesame cookies.

entries.name: Panificio Marè Prati
entries.description: Bread so good Trecca serves it at their tables. Order: pizza rossa (crispy, sweet-tangy tomato), lingue di gatto biscuits, strudel, jam-filled crostata.

entries.name: Forno Da Milvio
entries.description: Monti bakery. Order: deep-flavor chewy breads, light airy pizza (tomato, mortadella, or winter chicory & anchovy).
